title: Hilbert's Tenth Problem over the Rationals
exact_target: Can an algorithm always decide whether a polynomial equation with integer coefficients has a rational solution?

sources.citation: Sylvy Anscombe, Valentijn Karemaker, Zeynep Kisakürek, Vlerë Mehmeti, Margherita Pagano and Laura Paladino, A survey of local-global methods for Hilbert's Tenth Problem, abstract and Section1.
Hilbert's tenth problem for finitely generated rings.
Effectivity for existence of rational points is undecidable.
